headline: JazzCash Revenue Surges 67.6% in Q3 as Parent VEON Expands FinTech Footprint
summary: Pakistani mobile wallet platform JazzCash and associated financial services generated a 67.6% year-on-year revenue increase to Rs43.4 billion in Q3, driven by expanding digital transaction and mobile micro-lending volumes.
why: JazzCash is Pakistan's largest digital payments processor, backed by telecom group VEON.

impacts.name: VEON Ltd.
impacts.why: Rapid revenue expansion in digital wallet transactions strengthens non-telecom earnings.
